title: Synthetic mechanics descriptive demonstration
purpose: Demonstrates the deterministic descriptive analysis path over the synthetic demo fixture by quantifying record inventory, channel availability and provenance, value distributions, and per-lap sample yield. It exists to exercise plumbing and to estimate event yield and attrition mechanics; it makes no racing-performance claim.
limitations: Descriptive summaries carry no hypothesis test, interval, or confidence claim and cannot support any finding status stronger than the evidence gates allow.
Synthetic demonstration data cannot support any racing-performance conclusion.
